title: Banded Give-Back on Larger Rent Increases: Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
**Rule.** The give-back of a retention concession on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement is figured on the increase in bands measured against the rent before the increase:

- where the increase is **8 percent or more** of that rent, the part of the increase up to **5 percent** of that rent is given back at the retention share and the part above it at the share plus **20 percentage points**, never more than the whole of that part;
- where the increase is **5 percent or more but under 8 percent**, the part up to 5 percent is given back at the share and the part above it at the share plus **10 percentage points**, never more than the whole of that part;
- where the increase is **under 5 percent**, the whole increase is given back at the share.

The two banded amounts are added together, and the give-back is rounded down to the cent. The rent before the increase is the rent before change recorded on the increase notice.

## Worked figures (hypothetical, rent before the increase $150.00, so the first band is $7.50)

| Increase | Size against $150.00 | Share | Give-back before rounding |
|---|---|---|---|
| $18.00 | 12% | 60% | $7.50 at 60% is $4.50, plus $10.50 at 80% is $8.40, total $12.90 |
| $9.00 | 6% | 60% | $7.50 at 60% is $4.50, plus $1.50 at 70% is $1.05, total $5.55 |
| $6.00 | 4% | 60% | $6.00 at 60%, $3.60 |
| $18.00 | 12% | 85% | $7.50 at 85% is $6.375, plus the whole $10.50 (85% plus 20 points exceeds the whole part), total $16.875, rounded down to $16.87 |

## Edges
An increase of exactly $12.00 on $150.00 is 8 percent and falls in the top band; exactly $7.50 is 5 percent and falls in the middle band, with nothing above the first band.
